title: 第1166章 尼山圣域第1165章 殷辛非彼殷辛
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
孔玄笑了笑：“看来先生应该早已和赵寒接触过，对赵寒有所了解，甚至寄予厚望。”
孔凡眉头微皱，问道：“先祖，那么我们还继续帮殷辛针对其他三大圣地吗？”
孔玄点了点头道：“当然要继续。”
“先生是先生，儒门是儒门。”
“先生十万年前助我四大圣地脱离仙人之后，必然有他自己的盘算。”
“但我儒门今非昔比，和大殷彻底捆绑，即便先生也不能干涉。”
“何况，先生没问，那就是不知道。”
而在此刻，殷辛带着阴无极，来到了异空间尼山圣域。
这是一个有着超大山体的空间，山体巅峰矗立着儒圣孔玄的塑像，俯瞰全境。
半山腰上，有着十几座大型文庙。
山体之下是海量的古风书院，都是可供修炼的场所，且和外界有时速差别。
且在尼山圣域内，这些文庙和书院都无法被破坏。
自然而然，可以完美当做选拔的擂台使用。
此时此刻，便有三千门徒，正在书院内较量比试。
三千门徒其实相当于释门的八百罗汉和三千头陀，全是由神域境和凝神境组成。
其中凝神境无法参加，只能充当看客，坐于书院外侧观看着整个选拔。
而在半山腰的文庙内，则是七十二贤正在内部较量。
相对于释门内部选拔，各种大力出奇迹，佛光普照，金光闪烁，儒门这边就要好上不少。
较量看起来平平无奇，或是用拳，或是用剑，出手轻巧并未着急分出胜负。
亦或是两人站于原地，用真气以及精神力相互对峙。

甚至还有以各自学说辩论为主的口水战，而且还不少。
至少，当殷辛和阴无极，幻化了脸部后出现在观战人群内，便感觉相当有趣。
譬如其中一名年轻儒生，拿着折扇面对对手笑道：
“众所周知，人之初性本善，婴孩出生之际，懵懂无知干净单纯，不染一丝污秽。”
“但我认为，人之初性本恶，婴孩出生之际，饿了便哭闹，不顾生母疲惫而索取奶水，稍加触碰便也哭闹反抗，这不正是天性的自私自利吗！”
“刚一出生便索取无度，不满足便哭闹，这不是恶的源头那还是什么！”
“而且，纵观历史上的战争、掠夺、欺骗、杀戮、自私、嫉妒、虚荣从未不休，更加说明性本恶！”
而对手听后眉头则是一皱。
性本善和性本恶，在儒门几乎分为了两派阵营，即便是强如七十二贤，也各自有各自的见解，完全不统一。
“师兄，婴孩诞生之际心智未开，纯真无欲，没有恶念恶意，无害人之心，这便是至善的本源。”
“哪怕婴孩索取奶水，也是本能且无知的自保。”
“性本恶，那是蓄谋主动伤害他人，而婴孩没有主观意识，不具备这些恶性。”
……
双方不断地辩论，谁也说服不了谁。
这种场面在选拔当中还不少见，不止是性本善和性本恶的问题。
还有仁和义哪个最大，格物致知和发明本心，以及天人合一和天人相分的辩论。
唇枪舌剑看谁的嘴皮子更有说服力。
当殷辛看到这些辩论时，眉头微皱，似乎想到了什么。
无论是性本善还是性本恶，在殷辛眼里都没有错。
他更想说的是，性本利。
content_en:
Kong Xuan smiled: "It seems that sir has already been in contact with Zhao Han, knows something about Zhao Han, and even has high hopes for him."
Kong Fan frowned slightly and asked, "Ancestor, will we continue to help Yin Xin target the other three holy places?"
Kong Xuan nodded and said, "Of course I have to continue."
"Sir is a gentleman, Confucianism is Confucianism."
"After helping our Four Holy Lands escape from immortals a hundred thousand years ago, sir, he must have his own plans."
"But our Confucian sect is not what it used to be. We are completely tied to Da Yin. Even sir, we can't interfere."
"Besides, if you didn't ask, sir, you don't know."
At this moment, Yin Xin brought Yin Wuji to the Nishan Sanctuary in a different space.
This is a space with a huge mountain. At the top of the mountain stands a statue of Confucian sage Kong Xuan, overlooking the entire area.
Halfway up the mountain, there are more than a dozen large Confucian temples.
Under the mountain are a large number of ancient academies, all of which are places for cultivation, and the speed is different from the outside world.
And within the Nishan Sanctuary, these Confucian temples and academies cannot be destroyed.
Naturally, it can be used perfectly as a selection arena.
At this moment, there were three thousand disciples competing in the academy.
The three thousand disciples are actually equivalent to the eight hundred arhats and three thousand tutu of the Buddhist sect, which are all composed of the realm of the gods and the realm of concentration.
Among them, the Concentrating Realm was unable to participate and could only act as a spectator, sitting outside the academy and watching the entire selection.
In the Confucian Temple halfway up the mountain, seventy-two sages were competing internally.
Compared with the internal selection of the Buddhist sect, where all kinds of great efforts produce miracles, the Buddha's light shines everywhere, and the golden light shines, the Confucian sect is much better.
The contest seemed ordinary, with either fists or swords being used, the attacks were light and there was no rush to determine the winner.
Or the two of them stood there, confronting each other with their true energy and spiritual power.
There were even wars of words centered around debates on their respective doctrines, and there were quite a few.
At least, it was quite interesting when Yin Xin and Yin Wuji appeared in the crowd of spectators after their transformed faces.
For example, one of the young Confucian scholars held a folding fan and smiled at his opponent:
"As we all know, human beings are inherently good by nature. When a baby is born, he is ignorant, clean and simple, without a trace of filth."
"But I think that human nature is inherently evil. When a baby is born, he cries when he is hungry, asks for milk regardless of the mother's fatigue, and cries and resists even the slightest touch. Isn't this just selfish nature?"
"As soon as he was born, he demanded excessively and cried when he was not satisfied. If this is not the source of evil, then what else!"
"Moreover, throughout history, wars, plunder, deception, killing, selfishness, jealousy, and vanity have never ceased, which further proves that sex is inherently evil!"
The opponent frowned after hearing this.
Confucianism is almost divided into two camps about nature being good and nature being evil. Even those as powerful as the Seventy-Two Sages have their own opinions and are completely inconsistent.
"Brother, when a baby is born, his mind is not yet developed, he is pure and has no desires, has no evil thoughts and malice, and has no intention of harming others. This is the origin of the highest goodness."
"Even if a baby asks for milk, it is an instinctive and ignorant act of self-preservation."
"Nature is inherently evil, which means intentionally harming others. Babies do not have subjective consciousness and do not possess these evil qualities."
…
The two sides continued to argue, but no one could convince the other.
This kind of scene is not uncommon in selection. It is not just a question of inherently good and inherently evil people.
There are also debates about which is the greatest, benevolence or righteousness, the study of things to achieve knowledge and the original intention of invention, and the debate between the unity of nature and man and the separation of nature and man.
There was a fight of words to see whose words were more persuasive.
When Yin Xin saw these debates, he frowned slightly, as if he had thought of something.
Whether nature is inherently good or inherently evil, there is nothing wrong in Yin Xin's eyes.
What he wants to say more is that sex is beneficial.
